osm_secondary_check.interpretation: General location and footprint corroboration only. The OSM way has no Delta Zeta name and is not used as the primary identity or wall geometry source.

identity_evidence: Official Purdue GIS FID 752 identifies Delta Zeta, BLDG_ABBR SODZ, at 825 Hilltop Dr.
Current official Xi Omega chapter site gives 825 Hilltop Drive, West Lafayette; Purdue FSCL also lists the Delta Zeta chapter.

Purdue FSCL FAQ image and the Delta Zeta national chapter feature provide qualitative exterior support. The official Purdue photo description identifies red brick, broad concrete steps, wood double doors, a high arched window, globe lamp posts, and a stone chapter sign.
City permit search records identify a 2022 interior remodel and a 2023 exterior renovation at this address. These dates do not resolve the final as-built elevation.
geometry_edits: Replaced the legacy 14-vertex, 17-face blank L-shaped block with a detailed one-object shell following the complete 11-vertex official GIS wall footprint.

Added estimated two-level brick facade, repeated sash openings, double entrance doors with an arched glazed panel, broad entry steps, lamp-post proxies, and a stone chapter marker based on qualitative photo evidence.
Added schematic foyer, living room, dining room, and kitchen furniture modules for cutaway evidence; room types follow chapter-feature photo labels, while positions and sizes remain illustrative.

interpretation_and_uncertainty.story_count: Two modeled above-grade levels are an estimate. Purdue GIS NUM_LEVELS=1 and CountOfFLO=1 conflict; photo appearance and a third-party public-area summary only weakly suggest a taller house. No source confirms exact story count.
interpretation_and_uncertainty.height: Estimated eave 7.2 m and roof peak 9.0 m. GIS Extrution=36 is recorded but its unit and meaning are undocumented; no elevation or survey was found.
interpretation_and_uncertainty.roof: Low shallow ridge/cap is an estimate. Available source imagery and metadata do not resolve roof profile, pitch, or materials.
interpretation_and_uncertainty.facade: Brick and entrance composition have qualitative image support. Window count/rhythm, dimensions, exact entry-edge alignment, facade proportions, trim and roof material remain interpretive.
interpretation_and_uncertainty.interior: The cutaway is schematic, not a measured or current as-built floor plan. Room locations, dimensions, walls, and furniture are illustrative.
interpretation_and_uncertainty.site_elements: Entry landing, steps, lamps, and chapter marker are interpretive proxies. They are excluded from structural footprint metrics.
interpretation_and_uncertainty.crosswalk_candidate: README crosswalk row also lists Crosswalk Commons. This separate nearby property is associated with 925 Hilltop Drive in its own OSM data; it was neither edited nor merged into the Delta Zeta 825 Hilltop asset.
